closure.note: sum_k contribution_k = delta_local by linearity of a(S), q(S), b(C) and the bilinear term; this is an algebraic closure check, not a claim of explanatory correctness.

notes: remainder is the part of the full F change not represented by the one selected common-context view; it includes other views and any change in the view set.

Train-Train pairs describe the frozen function only. Train-Test/Train-Valid numbers are LOW_SUPPORT (7 Test molecules / 5 Train-Test components; 4 Valid molecules / 3 Train-Valid components among the interpretable pairs).

Closure of the word account is algebraic and does not establish a chemical causal law.
